scoreReasons: Business profiles at /.well-known/ucp are public and cacheable, so anyone can see which capabilities, transports, handlers and keys a domain advertises.
No public registry, index or explorer of UCP businesses exists, so finding profiles means crawling domains (unverified absence as of 2026-10-11).
Checkouts, orders, tokens and webhooks are bilateral and private; no ledger or public log records transactions.
Governance and releases are public: GitHub releases, Discussions, announcements and a meeting-minutes repository.
No merchant counts or volumes are published by Google or the project.

public.how: HTTP GET; Cache-Control public with max-age of at least 60 seconds. Shows ucp.version, services, capabilities, payment_handlers and keys.
Signed directory for Web Bot Auth shaped signatures.

public.where: The a2a service endpoint, for example /.well-known/agent-card.json
public.how: Public Agent Card describing the business agent.
Lists draft and dated versions; latest aliased to 2026-08-25 on 2026-10-11.

private.why: Point-to-point REST, MCP or A2A calls between platform and business.
Opaque tokens flow platform to business to PSP; never published.
